item.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs Selects Three Outstanding Embassy Cases for 'K-Initiative'... Awards Performance Bonuses (외교부, ‘K-이니셔티브’ 우수 공관 사례 3건 선정…포상금 지급)
item.description:
Ministry of Foreign Affairs Selects Three Outstanding Embassy Cases for 'K-Initiative'... Awards Performance Bonuses (외교부, ‘K-이니셔티브’ 우수 공관 사례 3건 선정…포상금 지급)

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced on the 8th that it has selected three outstanding cases from overseas diplomatic missions that contributed to the spread of the 'K-Initiative' and paid a total of 9 million won in special performance bonuses. (외교부는 ‘K-이니셔티브’ 확산에 기여한 재외공관 우수 사례 3건을 선정해 특별성과 포상금 총 900만원을 지급했다고 8일 밝혔다.)

The K-Initiative is a key national strategy of the Lee Jae-myung administration, which involves proactively utilizing Korean culture to solve international issues and promote national interests. (K-이니셔티브란 대한민국의 문화를 활용해 주도적으로 국제 현안을 해결하고 국익을 증진한다는 내용으로, 이재명 정부의 핵심 국가 전략이다.)

The Ministry selected three outstanding cases from the Embassy in Egypt, the Consulate General in Qingdao, and the Embassy in Peru, awarding 3 million won each to three primary contributors. (외교부는 주이집트대사관, 주칭다오총영사관, 주페루대사관의 우수 사례 3건을 선정하고 주된 공적자 3명에게 포상금을 각각 300만원씩 지급했다.)

These outstanding cases involve projects where overseas diplomatic missions, through the K-Initiative consultative bodies they operate, established preliminary project plans and collaborated with public institutions, companies, and overseas Koreans to achieve concrete results such as export contracts or revenue generation. (우수사례들은 재외공관이 운영하는 K-이니셔티브 협의체를 통해 사전 사업 계획을 수립하고 공공기관과 기업, 동포 등이 협업해 수출 계약이나 매출 달성 등 구체적인 성과를 이뤄낸 사업들이다.)

The Embassy in Egypt held a 'Korean Culture Week' in May last year to introduce Korean culture to the local community, resulting in over 160 export consultations worth approximately $8.5 million (around 12.8 billion won). As a result, contracts worth over $600,000 (around 900 million won) were actually signed. A total of 15,000 people participated in the Korean Culture Week in Egypt. (주이집트대사관은 지난 5월 현지 사회에 한국 문화를 소개하는 ‘한국 문화 주간’을 개최한 결과 160여 건, 약 850만달러(약 128억원) 규모의 수출 상담이 이뤄졌다. 그 결과 총 60만달러(약 9억원) 이상의 계약이 실제 성사됐다. 이집트 한국 문화 주간엔 총 1만5000여 명이 참가했다.)

The Consulate General in Qingdao participated as a guest of honor at the 'Shandong Province Imported Goods Expo' in April, operated a Korea Pavilion, and promoted products from 586 Korean companies. This led to on-site sales of products worth $53,500 (around 80 million won), and tourism promotional post views exceeded 59,700. (주칭다오총영사관은 지난 4월 ‘산둥성 수입 상품 박람회’에 주빈국으로 참가해 한국관을 운영하고 586개 우리 기업 제품을 홍보했다. 이를 통해 5만3500달러(약 8000만원) 상당의 제품을 현장에서 판매했고, 관광 홍보 게시물 조회 수도 5만9700회를 넘겼다.)

The Embassy in Peru held a Korea Expo on the occasion of 'Korea-Peru Friendship Day' in March, operating booths to introduce corporate products and hosting K-pop and traditional cultural performances. This resulted in sales of over $100,000 (around 150 million won) worth of products from local overseas Korean-run businesses. (주페루대사관은 지난 3월 ‘한-페루 우정의 날’을 계기로 한국 박람회를 열고 기업 제품 소개 부스 운영, K-팝 및 전통문화 공연 등을 진행했다. 이를 통해 10만달러(약 1억5000만원) 이상의 현지 동포 업체 제품을 판매했다.)

The Ministry stated, "We will strengthen cooperation with our public institutions, business community, overseas Korean society, and local governments, centering on overseas diplomatic missions, which serve as local bridgeheads for the overseas expansion of our culture, businesses, and industries." It added, "We will continue to make efforts to accelerate the spread of the K-Initiative and produce tangible results that the public can feel." (외교부는 “우리 문화, 기업, 산업 등 해외 진출의 현지 교두보인 재외공관을 중심으로 우리 공공기관, 경제계, 동포 사회, 지자체 등과의 협력을 강화해 나가겠다”며 “K-이니셔티브 확산을 가속화하고 국민들이 체감할 수 있는 가시적 성과를 도출해 나가기 위한 노력을 계속 경주해 나갈 예정”이라고 밝혔다.)

This marks the fourth time the Ministry of Foreign Affairs has paid special performance bonuses this year. Previously, in March, the Ministry paid a total of 6.05 million won to 12 employees who contributed to the President's visits to China and Japan; in April, a total of 100 million won to 23 employees of the Embassy in Iran related to the Middle East crisis; and in May, a total of 45.5 million won to 37 employees who contributed to responding to the Middle East War and supply chain crisis. (이번 외교부 특별 성과 포상금 지급은 올 들어 총 4번째다. 앞서 외교부는 지난 3월 대통령 방중·방일 유공 직원 12명에게 총 605만원, 4월 중동 위기 관련 주이란대사관 직원 23명에게 총 1억원, 5월 중동전쟁 및 공급망 위기 등 대응 유공 직원 37명에게 총 4550만원을 지급한 바 있다.)

item.title: Rep. Koh Min-jung Declares Candidacy for Party Leadership "Will Build a Young Democratic Party, Succeeding Moon Jae-in and Supporting Lee Jae-myung" (고민정 당대표 출마 선언 “젊은 민주당, 문재인 계승·이재명 뒷받침 민주당 만들겠다”)
item.description:
Rep. Koh Min-jung Declares Candidacy for Party Leadership "Will Build a Young Democratic Party, Succeeding Moon Jae-in and Supporting Lee Jae-myung" (고민정 당대표 출마 선언 “젊은 민주당, 문재인 계승·이재명 뒷받침 민주당 만들겠다”)

Rep. Koh Min-jung of the Democratic Party of Korea officially declared her candidacy for the party leadership election at the August 17 National Convention on the 8th. (더불어민주당 고민정 의원이 8일 8·17 전당대회 당대표 선거 출마를 공식 선언했다.)

At a press conference held at the National Assembly Communication Hall that morning, Rep. Koh stated, "I will create a path for a young Democratic Party that listens to the voices of youth externally and nurtures youth internally." She added, "I will work to ensure the Democratic Party becomes a 'party for everyone' that represents the interests of the majority of the people and improves their lives one by one." She further noted, "I will take the lead in creating a Democratic Party that inherits the achievements of Moon Jae-in, which have been undermined by the Yoon Suk-yeol government, and supports the success of a Lee Jae-myung administration." (고 의원은 이날 오전 국회 소통관에서 출마 기자회견을 하고 “밖으로는 청년의 목소리를 듣고, 안으로는 청년을 키우는 젊은 민주당의 길을 만들어 내겠다”고 했다. “민주당이 국민 다수의 이해를 대변하고 국민의 삶을 하나씩 개선해 나가는 ‘모두의 민주당’이 될 수 있도록 하겠다”고도 했다. 그러면서 “윤석열 정부에서 훼손한 문재인의 성과를 계승하고, 이재명 정부의 성공을 뒷받침하는 민주당을 만드는 데 앞장서겠다”고 했다.)

Rep. Koh emphasized, "The Democratic Party, as the ruling party responsible for the people's lives alongside a Lee Jae-myung administration, bears an endless responsibility for the daily lives of the people and the future of the Republic of Korea." (고 의원은 “민주당은 이재명 정부와 함께 국민의 삶을 책임져야 하는 집권 여당으로, 국민의 일상과 대한민국의 미래에 대한 무한 책임이 우리의 어깨 위에 있다”고 했다.)

Rep. Koh remarked, "However, in the recent local elections, public sentiment dealt a harsh blow to the Democratic Party. In particular, the youth in their 20s and 30s completely turned their backs on us." She criticized, "To them, the Democratic Party was seen as 'a vested interest group that created and ignored disparities,' 'a hypocritical force that climbed the ladder of social mobility and then kicked it away,' and 'a faction that focused on issues far removed from people's lives, repeating internal conflicts while neglecting to care for the public.'" (고 의원은 “그런데 지난 지방선거에서 민심은 민주당에 회초리를 드셨다”며 “특히 2030 청년 세대는 민주당을 철저하게 외면했다”고 했다. 이어 “그들에게 민주당은 ‘격차를 만들고 방치한 기득권 세력’ ‘계층 이동 사다리를 오른 뒤 걷어차 버린 위선적 세력’ ‘국민의 생활과는 거리가 먼 이슈로 우리 안의 갈등을 반복하며 국민의 삶을 돌보는 데는 부족한 세력’이었다”고 비판했다.)

Rep. Koh stressed, "Our Democratic Party must start anew by acknowledging this. Faced with the warning of public sentiment, we must intensely reflect on what we lacked and seek alternatives." (고 의원은 “이것을 인정하는 것에서 우리 민주당이 다시 시작해야 한다”며 “민심의 경고 앞에 우리가 부족했던 것이 무엇인지 치열하게 성찰하고 대안을 모색하는 것이 지금 우리가 해야 할 일”이라고 강조했다.)

Regarding internal party strife, Rep. Koh said, "If we remain mired in power struggles and repeat worthless debates unrelated to people's lives, winning general elections or regaining power will become difficult. We must set aside branding and derogatory language, recognize one another, communicate, and find alternatives." (고 의원은 당 내분과 관련해 “우리가 권력 투쟁에 매몰돼 국민 삶과 아무 관련도 없는 무가치한 논쟁을 반복한다면 총선 승리도, 정권 재창출도 어려워질 것”이라며 “낙인 찍기와 멸칭의 언어를 거두고, 상대를 인정하고 소통하며 대안을 찾아 나가야 한다”고 했다.)

Rep. Koh pledged that if elected party leader, she would introduce a 'youth quota system' allocating a certain percentage of party positions in the central and regional chapters to young people, and a 'party member deliberation committee' for thorough discussion in major policy decisions. She also proposed establishing a 'Youth Future Committee' directly under the party leader, with its chairperson being the youth deputy leader of the central party, to create a process for direct communication and discussion with the party leader. (고 의원은 당대표가 되면 중앙당과 시·도당 당직 일정 비율을 청년에게 주는 ‘청년 당직 할당제’와 당의 주요 정책 결정 과정에서 숙의를 거치는 ‘당원공론화위원회’를 도입하겠다고 했다. 또 당대표 직속으로 ‘청년미래위원회’를 두고, 위원장은 중앙당 청년부대표로 해 당대표와 직접 소통하고 논의하는 절차를 만들겠다고 했다.)

With Rep. Koh's candidacy, the Democratic Party leadership election will become a four-way race, including former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, who previously declared his candidacy, former leader Song Young-gil, who announced his candidacy on the same day, and former leader Jeong Cheong-rae, who is expected to seek re-election. (고 의원의 출마로 민주당 당대표 선거는 앞서 출마를 선언한 김민석 전 국무총리와 이날 출마를 선언하는 송영길 전 대표, 연임 도전이 전망되는 정청래 전 대표까지 4파전으로 치러진다.)

Rep. Koh is the only female candidate in her 40s among the four contenders. She was previously elected as a Supreme Council member in the party convention held in August 2022. <<>> (고 의원은 후보 4인 가운데 유일한 40대 여성 주자다. 2022년 8월 전당대회에서 최고위원 선거에 출마해 당선된 바 있다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae on Preferential Voting Debate: "You Can't Do Anything While Violating Party Constitution and Rules" (정청래, 선호투표제 논란에 “당헌·당규 위반하면서 뭘 할 수는 없는 것”)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae on Preferential Voting Debate: "You Can't Do Anything While Violating Party Constitution and Rules" (정청래, 선호투표제 논란에 “당헌·당규 위반하면서 뭘 할 수는 없는 것”)

Regarding the decision by the Democratic Party of Korea's National Convention Preparation Committee to adopt a preferential voting system for the August 17 party leadership election, former Representative Jung Cheong-rae stated on the 8th, "You can't do anything while violating the party constitution and rules." Although Jung had said the previous day, "I respect and accept the committee's decision," the pro-Jung faction released a statement that day opposing the preferential voting system, claiming it is invalid as a violation of the party constitution and rules. (더불어민주당 전당대회준비위원회가 8·17 전당대회 당대표 선거를 선호투표제 방식으로 하기로 결정한 데 대해 정청래 전 대표는 8일 “당헌·당규를 위반하면서 무엇을 할 수는 없는 것”이라고 말했다. 정 전 대표는 전날 “전준위 결정을 존중하고 수용한다”고 했었으나, 친청계는 이날 선호투표제에 대해 당헌·당규 위반으로 무효라며 반대한다는 입장을 내놨다.)

After attending a policy forum on the success of the southwestern semiconductor cluster held at the National Assembly Members' Office Building that morning, Jung met with reporters and said, "Yesterday, I said I respect and accept the decision of the National Convention Preparation Committee, but since then, there has been controversy over violations of the party constitution and rules, so I reviewed them." (정 전 대표는 이날 오전 국회의원회관에서 열린 ‘서남권 반도체 클러스터 성공을 위한 정책 토론회’에 참석한 뒤 기자들과 만나 “어제 전준위(전당대회준비위원회) 결정을 존중하고 수용한다고 말했는데, 그 이후로 당헌·당규 위반이라는 논란이 있어 당헌·당규를 살펴봤다”고 했다.)

Jung then looked at notes he had saved on his phone and said, "According to Article 25, Paragraph 1, Clause 4 of the party constitution, it states, 'The party leader is elected by a majority of votes. Specific matters such as conducting a runoff election for this purpose are determined by party rules.' And Article 66 (Paragraph 1, Clause 1) of the party rules (Regulations on Election of Party Officers) states, 'In the party leadership election, the candidate receiving a majority of votes is elected. The specific method for conducting a runoff election for this purpose is set by the National Convention Preparation Committee but is finalized through resolutions by the Supreme Council and the Party Affairs Committee, and the specific voting method is determined by the Election Management Committee.'" (정 전 대표는 이어 휴대전화에 적어둔 메모를 보며 “당헌 25조 1항 4호를 보면, ‘당대표는 과반수의 득표로 선출한다. 이를 위한 결선투표 실시 등 구체적인 사항은 당규로 정한다’고 돼 있고, 당규(당직선출규정) 66조(1항 1호)에는 ‘당대표 선거는 과반수 득표자를 당선인으로 한다. 이를 위한 결선투표 실시의 구체적인 방법은 전준위에서 정하되, 최고위원회와 당무위원회의 의결을 통해 확정하며, 구체적인 투표 방법은 선거관리위원회가 정한다’고 돼 있다”고 했다.)

He added, "When I heard this, I thought, 'What do we do?'" effectively lending weight to the claim that implementing preferential voting instead of a runoff election violates the party constitution and rules. Jung said, "Just as you can't do anything while violating the constitution and laws, isn't it also not permissible to conduct the party leadership election while violating the party constitution and rules? I was also quite taken aback." (그러면서 “저도 이 이야기를 듣고 ‘어떡하나’ 하는 생각이 들었다”며 결선투표가 아닌 선호투표를 하는 것이 당헌·당규 위반이라는 주장에 사실상 무게를 실었다. 정 전 대표는 “헌법·법률을 위반하면서 (무엇을) 할 수 없듯이, (당대표 선거를) 당헌·당규를 위반하면서 할 수 있는 것은 아니지 않으냐”며 “저도 좀 당혹스러웠다”고 했다.)

Jung stated, "I have no intention of quibbling over the primary election rules, but if there is a potential controversy over violating the party constitution and rules, it will cause significant confusion among party members, so I hope it gets sorted out well. I hope the National Convention Preparation Committee or the Supreme Council will make a wise decision." (정 전 대표는 “경선 룰을 갖고 시비를 할 생각이 없지만, 당헌·당규 위반 논란 소지가 있으면 당원들 사이에 큰 혼란이 있기 때문에, 어쨌든 잘 정리됐으면 좋겠다”며 “전준위나 최고위에서 현명하게 잘 결정하기를 바란다”고 했다.)

Former Representative Song Young-gil, who announced his candidacy that morning, said of the preferential voting system, "It eliminates the vote-splitting psychology," adding, "For me, it seems like it could be a winning card." Regarding this remark, Jung said, "If he said that, wouldn't it be a good thing if it benefits him?" He added, "I'm taking the position of accepting the committee's decision without considering advantages or disadvantages." (이날 오전 출마 선언을 한 송영길 전 대표는 선호투표제에 대해 “사표 심리가 없어지게 됐다”며 “저로서는 승리의 카드가 된 것 아닌가 싶다”고 했다. 이 발언에 대해 정 전 대표는 “그렇게 말씀하셨다면, 본인에게 유리하다면 좋은 것 아니겠느냐”고 했다. 그러면서 “저는 유불리를 생각하지 않고 전준위 결정을 수용한다는 입장”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Song Young-gil Announces Candidacy for Party Leader: “I Will Turn a Shaky Party into a True Ruling Party” (송영길 당대표 출마 선언 “흔들리는 당을 ‘진짜 여당’으로 만들겠다”)
item.description:
Song Young-gil Announces Candidacy for Party Leader: “I Will Turn a Shaky Party into a True Ruling Party” (송영길 당대표 출마 선언 “흔들리는 당을 ‘진짜 여당’으로 만들겠다”)

Former Democratic Party of Korea leader Song Young-gil officially declared his candidacy for the party leadership in the August 17 national convention on the 8th, stating, “I will transform our shaky party into a true ruling party once again.” (더불어민주당 송영길 전 대표가 8일 “흔들리는 당을 다시 진짜 여당으로 탈바꿈시키겠다”며 8·17 전당대회 당대표 선거 출마를 공식 선언했다.)

In a press conference held at the party headquarters in Yeouido, Seoul, that morning, former leader Song asserted, “The success of the President Yoon administration is synonymous with the Democratic Party’s responsibility. The president should not have to walk through a thorny path alone; the Democratic Party must walk that path together.” <<> Referring to the June 1 local elections, Song said, “It was a defeat disguised as victory. The people have shown the Democratic Party a yellow card in this local election. If we take it lightly, the next general election will be a red card.” He added, “Losing the general election will mean no chance of regaining power, and without regaining power, we cannot guarantee the success of the Yoon administration.” <<> Song characterized this convention as “a choice not about who is more progressive, but about who can earn the people’s trust and lead the Democratic Party to victory—someone who will cooperate with the Yoon administration to create an irreplaceable Republic of Korea.” <<> “Whose face should we present for the general election?” Song questioned, claiming, “Song Young-gil is the winning card for the general election. I have experience in stabilizing a shaken party.” He argued, “After the crushing defeat in the April 7 by-elections in 2021, I became the party leader, restored the collapsed center of the party, and conducted the fierce primary for the presidential election more fairly than anyone else.” <<> If elected party leader again, Song pledged, “I will decisively tame the runaway housing market. By developing hundreds of thousands of pyeong of the returned U.S. military base site in Yongsan, Seoul, I will supply 50,000 apartments of 24 to 32 pyeong at reasonable prices to youth, newlyweds, and non-homeowners.” He also said, “Public rental housing on public land will allow renters to buy homes at the initial sales price anytime, and if housing prices rise, that increase will be shared with the renters.” <<> Song stated, “I will send 100,000 young people who are unable to find jobs abroad, supporting their airfare and stay expenses.” He also promised, “The university dormitory occupancy rate will be raised from the current 20% to 50%.” Additionally, he said, “I will remove the obstacles blocking the stock market’s upward trend. Once elected, I will pass the ‘Stock Price Suppression Prevention Act,’ promote separate taxation of dividend income, and create a ‘Super ISA (Individual Savings Account)’ for youth to build their seed money.” <<> Regarding party operations, Song proposed, “I will achieve party member sovereignty through AI (Artificial Intelligence),” and announced the creation of an ‘AI Party Members’ Square’ where members can express opinions. He also promised to build a ‘Digital Direct Democracy Policy Reflection System’ to convey members’ views to the presidential office and government for incorporation into state affairs. Noting that “without the support of the 2030 generation, there will be no election victory in 2030,” Song pledged to appoint two ex-officio supreme council members from the 20s and 30s age groups and establish a ‘2030 Special Committee’ to involve that generation in major party decisions. <<> After the press conference, in a meeting with reporters, Song commented on the previous day’s decision by the party convention preparation committee to hold the leadership election using a preferential voting system, saying, “Since anyone who votes for both first and second choices will have their votes combined, resulting in a majority winner, this creates an atmosphere where people can vote for Song Young-gil without burden. I think this has become a winning card for me.” <<> Attending the press conference were lawmakers Min Hong-chul (four-term), Kim Young-ho (three-term), Min Byeong-deok and Heo Jong-sik (two-term), Park Seon-won (first-term), and former lawmaker Kim Doo-gwan. Former presidential spokesman Kang Min-seok, who served under the Moon Jae-in administration, hosted the declaration event. <<> Former leader Song, a six-term lawmaker, was elected Democratic Party leader in May 2021 and oversaw the party’s primary for the presidential election, which unfolded between President Yoon and former Prime Minister Lee Nak-yon. He resigned as party leader in May 2022, taking responsibility for President Yoon’s defeat by a 0.73 percentage point margin to former President Yoon Suk-yeol. Subsequently, he ran as the Democratic Party candidate for Seoul mayor in the June 2022 local elections and lost. After the ‘money envelopes at the national convention’ scandal emerged, he left the party and was indicted in custody. He was acquitted in the second trial in February and reinstated in the party. (송 전 대표는 이날 오전 서울 여의도 당사에서 출마 기자회견을 하고 “이재명 정부의 성공은 곧 민주당의 책임”이라며 “대통령 혼자 가시밭길을 걸어가게 해서는 안 된다. 민주당이 함께 그 길을 걸어야 한다”고 주장했다.)

item.title: Joint Rally of Army, Navy, and Air Force Academy Alumni Associations: "Reconsider Military Academy Integration from Square One" (육·해·공사 총동창회 궐기대회…“사관학교 통합, 원점 재검토하라”)
item.description:
Joint Rally of Army, Navy, and Air Force Academy Alumni Associations: "Reconsider Military Academy Integration from Square One" (육·해·공사 총동창회 궐기대회…“사관학교 통합, 원점 재검토하라”)

The alumni associations of the Army, Navy, and Air Force Academies held a general rally on the 8th, voicing unified opposition to the government's policy on integrating the military academies. (육군·해군·공군사관학교 총동창회가 8일 총궐기대회를 열고 정부의 사관학교 통합 정책에 일제히 반대 목소리를 냈다.)

On that morning, the joint alumni associations of the three academies, alongside People Power Party lawmakers Han Ki-ho and Lim Jong-deuk, held a rally on the steps of the main building of the National Assembly in Yeouido, Seoul, under the banner "National General Rally Against the Merger of the Army, Navy, and Air Force Academies and the Relocation of the Army Academy." They demanded the halt of the academy integration push and a "return to square one for reconsideration." (육·해·공사 총동창회는 이날 오전 서울 여의도 국회 본관 계단에서 국민의힘 한기호·임종득 의원 등과 함께 ‘육·해·공군사관학교 통폐합 및 육군사관학교 지방 이전 반대 국민 총궐기대회’를 개최하고 사관학교 통합 추진 중단과 ‘원점 재검토’를 요구했다.)

This marks the first time the joint alumni associations have taken collective action on the issue of the . The event involved 42 organizations, including former Army Academy superintendents, as well as retired generals. Some opposition party lawmakers also joined as speakers before the main event began. According to the organizers, approximately 2,000 people participated. (육·해·공사 총동창회가 문제와 관련해 집단행동에 나선 것은 처음이다. 역대 육사 교장단을 비롯한 42개 단체와 예비역 장성 등이 참여했고 일부 야당 의원도 본행사 시작 전 발언자로 합류했다. 주최 측 추산 약 2000명이 참가했다.)

In the resolution adopted that day, the joint alumni associations stated, "The merger of the military academies and the relocation of the Army Academy to a provincial area are significant national issues that could affect the history, traditions, identity, expertise, and overall national security of the armed forces." They criticized the government, saying, "Despite the need for objective verification, public consensus, and social agreement, the government is pushing ahead with this hastily, ignoring these requirements." (육·해·공사 총동창회는 이날 결의문에서 “사관학교 통폐합과 육사 지방 이전은 국군의 역사와 전통, 정체성과 전문성, 국가 안보 전반에 영향을 미칠 수 있는 중대한 국가적 현안”이라며 “객관적인 검증과 국민적 공감대, 사회적 합의를 바탕으로 추진돼야 함에도 정부가 이를 무시한 채 졸속으로 추진하고 있다”고 했다.)

They further urged that if reforms to the military academies are truly necessary, a consultative body should be formed, including military experts, senior military figures, educators, and parents of cadets, to design the policy openly and objectively. (그러면서 만약 사관학교 개혁이 꼭 필요하다면 군사 전문가와 군 원로, 교육계, 사관생도 학부모 등이 참여하는 협의 기구를 구성해 공개적이고 객관적으로 정책을 설계해야 한다고 촉구했다.)

They added, "Until our demands are met, we will continue to fight within the bounds of the law for national security, the future of the armed forces, and the safety and peaceful lives of the people." (이어 “요구가 관철될 때까지 국가 안보와 국군의 미래, 국민의 안전과 평화로운 삶을 위해 합법적인 범위 내에서 끝까지 투쟁하겠다”고 했다.)

Park Pan-jun, head of the Army Academy Alumni Association, pointed out, "The merger promoted by the government does not contribute to strengthening joint operations or recruiting outstanding cadets. National security should not be used as an experiment or, even worse, as a political sacrifice." (박판준 육사 총동창회장은 “정부가 추진하는 통폐합은 합동성 강화나 우수 생도 모집에 도움이 되지 않는다”며 “안보는 실험 대상이 돼선 안 되고 정치적 제물이 되어선 더더욱 안 된다”고 지적했다.)

The alumni associations of the Naval Academy and Air Force Academy were represented by their respective secretaries-general, who each stated their positions. (해사, 공사 총동창회는 사무총장들이 참가해 각자 입장을 밝혔다.)

Jung Seok-kyun, Secretary-General of the Naval Academy Alumni Association, said, "Naval cadets must grow into naval officers while seeing and smelling the sea," warning that integration could undermine the expertise and identity of naval officers. Wi Kang-bok, Secretary-General of the Air Force Academy Alumni Association, also noted that under the integration plans under discussion, "It would be very difficult to timely cultivate elite officers specialized in air and space environments." (정석균 해사 총동창회 사무총장은 “해군사관생도는 바다를 보고 바다의 냄새를 맡으며 해군 장교로 성장해야 한다”며 통합이 해군 장교의 전문성과 정체성을 훼손할 수 있다고 했다. 위강복 공사 총동창회 사무총장도 논의 중인 통합 방안으로는 “공중, 우주 환경에 특화된 정예 장교를 적기에 양성하기가 매우 어렵다”고 했다.)

The Ministry of National Defense is pursuing a reform plan that would establish a "National Defense Academy" to integrate the selection of cadets from the Army, Navy, and Air Force Academies, aiming to strengthen joint military capabilities. (국방부는 군의 합동성 강화 등을 위해 ‘국군사관학교’를 창설해 육·해·공군 사관학교 생도들을 통합 선발하는 개혁 방안을 추진 중이다.)

The plan envisions that first- and second-year students at the National Defense Academy would receive common education together for all three branches, while third- and fourth-year students would undergo specialized education for their respective services. The Jaundae area in Daejeon is being discussed within and outside the military as a potential site for the common education, but the Ministry of National Defense maintains that "specific plans have not been finalized." (국군사관학교 1·2학년엔 육·해·공군 생도가 함께 공통 교육을 받고, 3·4학년엔 각 군별 특화 전공 교육을 받도록 한다는 구상이다. 공통 교육 장소로는 대전 자운대가 군 안팎에서 거론되고 있지만, 국방부는 “구체적 방안은 확정되지 않았다”는 입장이다.)

item.title: Legislation Committee Unilaterally Pushes Forward... ‘Abolition of Supplementary Investigation Rights’ on Agenda (與 법사위 단독 강행... ‘보완수사권 폐지’ 상정)
item.description:
On the 8th, the National Assembly’s Legislation and Judiciary Committee held a plenary session led by the Democratic Party of Korea, following the walkout of the People Power Party in protest over committee formation negotiations and discussions on revising the Criminal Procedure Act. The Committee placed a bill to revise the Criminal Procedure Act, which aims to abolish prosecutors’ supplementary investigation rights, on the agenda of the plenary session, and it is expected to be reviewed by the First Subcommittee on Bill Review on the 10th. <<> People Power Party lawmakers protested inside the meeting room for about five minutes immediately after the session began. They held placards reading phrases like ‘Intimidation and disregard for the people in committee formation’ and ‘Building up to nullify trials through obsession with the Legislation Committee,’ then left the room. <<> Kim Seung-soo, the People Power Party’s Deputy Chief Whip for Operations, later told reporters, “The Legislation Committee must be normalized” and urged, “Acknowledge the opposition’s checks and balances, and have the Democratic Party immediately enter into good-faith negotiations on forming the committee.” <<> After the People Power Party lawmakers exited, Seo Young-kyo, the Democratic Party chair of the Legislation Committee, resumed the session. The Committee formed the First Subcommittee on Bill Review that day and placed the Criminal Procedure Act amendment on the agenda. Kim Yong-min, a Democratic Party member of the Committee, stated, “Only 86 days remain until the abolition of the prosecution service,” adding, “We must completely abolish prosecutors’ direct investigation and supplementary investigation rights and unify the investigative authority under judicial police officers.” He continued, “The separation of investigation and prosecution is a fundamental principle that must be upheld and can never be compromised.” <<> However, regarding the ‘Jang Yun-gi case,’ where suspicions of an organized cover-up by the police have emerged, opinions within the Democratic Party have surfaced about the need for supplementary mechanisms for police investigations. Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Nam-hee said, “In cases like this, where police collude with suspects or destroy evidence, we need a system to prevent such occurrences or detect problems.” <<> In response, Minister of Justice Chung Sung-ho stated, “Since the police have said they will conduct strict internal audits and prepare related measures, we will wait and see.” <<> Regarding suspicions of evidence tampering, Minister Chung explained, “There were 11 matters that were not properly handled at the police level and had to be supplemented by the prosecution. In that process, suspicions (related to evidence destruction) arose, leading to a thorough review.” <<> When asked if the prosecution was using this suspicion as ‘media play’ to argue for the necessity of supplementary investigation rights, Minister Chung rebutted, saying, “Necessary measures are being taken in Gwangju, and the media is intensively covering it, leading to articles. Suggesting that this is media play with ulterior motives is an excessive misunderstanding.” <<> Earlier that day, the People Power Party, through a commentary by Senior Spokesperson Park Seong-hoon, criticized, “In a situation where suspicions of an organized police cover-up are pouring in, trying to eliminate checks and balances is not reform but an idea to turn power agencies into absolute power with no oversight.” <<> The Legislation Committee had planned to process 44 bills transferred from other standing committees that day, in addition to the Criminal Procedure Act amendment. However, Chair Seo stated, “The Democratic Party’s leadership requested that we defer the passage of bills from other standing committees to allow the People Power Party to attend the standing committees,” and announced that the processing of related agenda items would be postponed. <<> Meanwhile, lawmakers from the Democratic Party and the Fatherland Innovation Party on the Legislation Committee held a press conference that day and stated, “Reform of the criminal justice system is a task that can no longer be delayed,” adding, “We must open the First Subcommittee on Bill Review on the 10th and begin reviewing key bills, including the Criminal Procedure Act amendment to abolish prosecutors’ supplementary investigation rights.” (국회 법제사법위원회는 8일 국민의힘이 원 구성 협상과 형사소송법 개정 논의에 항의하며 퇴장한 가운데 더불어민주당 주도로 전체회의를 열었다. 법사위는 검사의 보완수사권 폐지를 골자로 하는 형사소송법 개정안을 전체회의에 상정하고, 오는 10일 법안심사1소위원회에서 심사할 전망이다.)

item.title: President Lee Meets with Norwegian Prime Minister: "Congratulations on Reaching the World Cup Quarterfinals... I Watched the Video, You Played Well" (李대통령, 노르웨이 총리 회담 “월드컵8강 축하... 영상보니 잘 하더라“)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, who is visiting Türkiye for the NATO (North Atlantic Treaty Organization) Summit, held a summit meeting with Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre on the 8th (local time) to discuss bilateral cooperation plans. (나토(NATO·북대서양조약기구) 정상회의 참석을 계기로 튀르키예를 방문 중인 이재명 대통령은 8일(현지 시각) 요나스 가르 스퇴르 노르웨이 총리와 정상회담을 하고 양국 협력 방안을 논의했다.)

During the 36-minute meeting with Prime Minister Støre, President Lee stated, "The current international situation is highly unstable," and emphasized that "at times like this, when it is limited for individual nations to overcome the crisis, international cooperation and exchange become even more important." He added, "South Korea and Norway are developing into a deep relationship where we greatly benefit each other in the fields of economy, industry, culture, and defense," and proposed, "Let's have an in-depth discussion on which areas we should further deepen our ties in the future." (이 대통령은 이날 스퇴르 총리와 36분간 가진 회담에서 “현재 국제 정세가 매우 불안정한 상태”라며 “국가 단위에서 이 위기를 극복하기에 제한적인 이런 때일수록 국가 간 협력과 교류가 중요하다”고 했다. 그러면서 “대한민국과 노르웨이는 경제, 산업, 문화, 국방 영역에서 큰 도움을 받는 깊은 관계로 발전하고 있다”며 “앞으로 어떤 분야에서 관계를 깊게 만들어갈지 깊이 있게 논의하자”고 했다.)

President Lee expressed familiarity by telling Prime Minister Støre, "This is the second time we meet," and then conveyed his gratitude, saying, "South Korea has not forgotten and remembers with appreciation that Norway provided medical support during the Korean War (1950-1953) even before establishing diplomatic relations with South Korea." (이 대통령은 스퇴르 총리에게 “두 번째 뵙는다”며 친근감을 표시한 뒤 “대한민국은 노르웨이가 대한민국과 외교 관계를 맺기도 전인 6·25(전쟁) 당시 의료 지원을 해준 점을 잊지 않고 기억하며 감사하게 생각한다”고 사의를 표했다.)

Prime Minister Støre responded to President Lee, saying, "I met you last year at the G20 Summit, and now we meet again," recalling, "I have fond memories of the extensive discussions we had about bilateral relations during the dinner last year, and since then, there has been significant development in the potential between Norway and South Korea." He continued, "There was an important decision in the defense sector between our two countries, and it was a good decision for advancing the strategic partnership," adding, "We continue to make progress in security, trade, and technology." This appears to refer to Hanwha Aerospace's contract signed earlier this year to supply a full package worth a total of $922 million (approximately 1.3 trillion won), including the Chunmoo rocket launcher and guided missiles, to Norway. (스퇴르 총리는 이 대통령에게 “작년 G20 정상회의를 계기로 뵙고 다시 만나게 됐다”며 “작년 만찬 때 대통령님과 양국 관계에 대해 많은 대화를 나눴던 좋은 기억이 나는데, 그 이후 노르웨이와 한국 간 잠재성에서 많은 발전이 있었다”고 했다. 이어 “양국 국방 분야에서 중요한 결정이 있었는데 전략 파트너십 발전을 위해 좋은 결정이었다”며 “안보·교역·기술 분야에서 (양국이 앞으로) 계속 나아가고 있다”고 했다. 이는 한화에어로스페이스가 올 초 노르웨이에 천무와 유도 미사일 등 총 9억2200만달러(약 1조3000억원) 규모의 풀패키지 공급 계약을 체결한 것 등을 거론한 것으로 보인다.)

During the meeting, President Lee also brought up Norway's advancement to the World Cup quarterfinals and the selection of a submarine jointly designed with Germany as the preferred bidder for Canada's submarine project. At the start of the meeting, President Lee mentioned to Prime Minister Støre, "I think I should first offer my congratulations. You made it to the World Cup quarterfinals and were also selected for the (Canadian) submarine project." (이 대통령은 회담에서 노르웨이가 월드컵 8강에 진출한 것과 함께 독일과 공동 설계한 잠수함이 캐나다 잠수함 사업 우선협상 대상자로 선정된 것을 화제로 올렸다. 이 대통령은 회담을 시작하며 스퇴르 총리에게 “먼저 축하 말씀을 드려야 할 것 같다. 월드컵 8강에도 가고 (캐나다) 잠수함 (사업) 선정도 됐다”고 언급한 것이다.)

Prime Minister Støre replied, "I am pleased with these achievements at the national level," adding, "This is the first time since 1998 that Norway has achieved such a high result in the World Cup, and defeating Brazil in the Round of 16 is also very gratifying." He continued, "We'll have to see how the match against England in the quarterfinals goes, but I think it will go well. We have many good players, and they are performing well as a team." In response, President Lee remarked, "I watched the video of the Norwegian team after the Round of 16, and they were very impressive," and then made the so-called Norwegian 'Viking clap' gesture by clenching his fists and mimicking a rowing motion, adding, "I hope I get to see you row one more time," conveying his support. (스퇴르 총리는 “국가 차원에서 성과를 내 기쁘다”며 “1998년 이후에 높은 월드컵 성적을 낸 것은 처음인데 (16강전에서) 브라질에 승리한 것 또한 매우 기쁘다”고 화답했다. 이어 “영국과 (월드컵 8강전) 경기가 어떻게 될지 지켜봐야겠지만, 잘될 것”이라며 “좋은 선수가 많지만, 팀으로 잘 선전하고 있다”고 했다. 이에 이 대통령은 “16강전 후 노르웨이팀 영상을 봤는데 아주 좋았다”며 주먹을 쥐고 노를 젓는 동작을 취하는 이른바 노르웨이의 ‘바이킹 노 젓기’ 응원 제스처를 해 보이고는 “한 번 더 젓길 기대한다”고 응원의 뜻을 전했다.)
